text:
Maya Khan: Heads-up team — finalizing the release announcement for the inference pricing + optimize updates. Target publish: Thu 9:00am PT. Need eng confirmation for changelog URL, docs push timing, and whether we should hold the public benchmarks until the webinar recap lands.

Cheng Li: changelog will be generated from the release PR, URL will be https://redwood-internal/docs/changelog/v0.9 once published. Docs push window looks good but I need a green from ops on deploy timing.

Dan Torres: I can merge the docs PRs by 07:30am PT. I'll create the canonical docs landing at /docs/release/v0.9 and the changelog redirect by 08:15am PT. Any specific blurb you want in the "What's new" section?

Olivia Park: For benchmarks — we should call out median 95th latency and cost-per-token delta vs baseline. Draft line: "median p95 latency down 18% at production batch sizes (see benchmark appendix)". Do we have appendix numbers cleared by ML?

Sam R: Draft social/post copy (very short):
```
Introducing Redwood Optimize: better batching, smarter routing, and lower unit costs. Learn how we cut p95 latency by ~18% and reduced token cost by 25% for common chat workloads. Webinar + benchmarks: link in bio.
```
Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya Patel: Quick ops ask — Dedicated rollout will be staged (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Recommend 15min buffer between steps in case we need a rollback. If marketing must hold publish until 2nd stage, say so.

Maya Khan: Ok — marketing can align to staged rollout. We'll target 09:15am PT publish for the public blog/announce so the canary has a chance to surface issues. Webinar invite still for 10am PT. Can Cheng/ops confirm the canary start time? Also, small docs bug in the quickstart snippet — need a cherrypick before merge.

Cheng Li: Ops confirmed: canary starts 08:40am PT, 10% to 50% at 08:55am PT, full at 09:10am PT. We'll hold public announce until 09:15am PT as requested. I will apply the quick cherrypick for the snippet now.

Dan Torres: Cherrypick applied and new build triggered. Docs canonical link: https://redwood.ai/docs/release/v0.9 — changelog redirect will live at https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v0.9 in ~20m. I added a short "What's new" paragraph pulled from the benchmark appendix.

Olivia Park: Nice — ML reviewed the appendix and approved the numbers. Please use exact wording: "p95 latency improved 18% in production batching; token cost reduction ~24% across our common prompt mix." I'll attach the appendix PDF to the webinar slide deck.

release-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2026-04-15T08:40:00Z -> stage1 10% (08:40Z), stage2 50% (08:55Z), full (09:10Z). Monitor: /ops/deploys/17677. Alerts: eng-oncall.

Priya Patel: Thanks Cheng — we'll watch the metrics and pause if error rate >0.5% sustained.

Sam R: Updated post to reference the new publish time and final link placeholders. Full announce copy snippet below — marketing will QA and drop into CMS at 09:00am PT for scheduled publish at 09:15am PT:
"Redwood Optimize reduces median p95 latency by 18% and lowers token costs by 24% for common chat workloads. Read the benchmarks and join our 10am webinar for a deep dive: https://redwood.ai/blog/release-v0.9 -> docs/release/v0.9"

Maya Khan: Perfect. Dan / Cheng — please post the final changelog + docs links here when live and tag @marketing. Olivia — can you attach the appendix to the webinar calendar invite?

Dan Torres: Links live now: changelog https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v0.9, docs landing https://redwood.ai/docs/release/v0.9. Marking PR as merged.

Cheng Li: Can confirm cherrypick deployed. Monitoring looks green so far.

Olivia Park: Appendix attached to calendar. Webinar slide deck updated.

Maya Khan: Thanks everyone — scheduling publish job now. :rocket:

Sam R: On publish, I'll drop the social thread and the webinar reminder 5m out. :thumbsup:

Maya Khan: closing thread here — will post post-mortem/engage notes after the webinar. :white_check_mark:
